tools_attempted: rg for MOESM/supplement links in XML and local HTML landing assets
unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The XML advertises Supplementary Dataset 1 as 41598_2018_27417_MOESM1_ESM.doc, but the local paper package contains only repeated HTML landing-page .bin assets and no local .doc/.docx/.xls/.xlsx supplement file. The methods text describes the supplement as donor characteristics for saliva samples; gate-relevant activity, toxicity, identity, and mechanism values were recovered from XML/PDF text.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Nonblocking caution: donor-characteristic supplement content is unavailable locally, but it is not needed to support the recovered MIC, FICI, HGF-1 MTT, database, or mechanism claims.

nonblocking_cautions.evidence_context: The dbAMP row is a mixed multi-PMID/multi-target database entry; current-paper-supported C. albicans values are preserved separately and the broader row remains source_conflict.
The paper uses potentiation/synergized language in places, but the source FICI value is 0.75 and is categorized by the authors as additive by EUCAST.
Figure-only curve/bar values were not invented; source text values and qualitative thresholds were preserved.
Local supplement assets are HTML landing pages; XML-linked Word supplement is absent locally and appears limited to saliva donor characteristics.
Direct microscopy supports cell entry/growth arrest; the source does not identify the exact cellular target.
